title: Pumpkin seeds habit
caption:
The snack you're probably throwing away 🎃

Pumpkin seeds bring plant protein, magnesium, zinc and good fats in a small handful.

Roast them lightly, sprinkle on curd, oats or salads, or just snack on them at 4 PM instead of biscuits.
